unavailable.title: Mailbox status is unavailable
unavailable.description: We could not check your mailbox right now. Try again when you are ready.

notConfigured.title: Mailbox is not configured
notConfigured.description: Ask your administrator to set up mailbox access for your account.

provisioning.title: Mailbox setup is in progress
provisioning.description: Your mailbox is being prepared. Refresh this status to check again.

suspended.title: Mailbox is suspended
suspended.description: Mailbox access is temporarily unavailable. Contact your administrator if this continues.

error.title: Mailbox needs attention
error.description: Mailbox access is unavailable right now. Refresh the status or contact your administrator.

deleting.title: Mailbox is being removed
deleting.description: Mailbox access is unavailable while this account is being removed.

active.title: Mailbox is ready
active.workspace: Your Mail workspace will appear here as more mailbox features become available.
